narrative.overview: A compact native prayer timetable that belongs to the current Omarchy desktop. Clear prayer times lead; the theme supplies the font, foreground, surface, and accent. The 24-hour orbit explains the day without competing with the countdown.
keyCharacteristics: Aligned times with explicit next-prayer emphasis
Flat tonal surfaces and restrained motion

rules.name: The Theme Rule
rules.body: Preserve dynamic theme expressions; a screenshot’s colors are evidence of one theme, not a new palette.

dos: Do preserve live Omarchy theme bindings.
Do keep Arabic labels readable and numeric times unmirrored.
Do show the next prayer and its exact time before settings.
donts: Don’t introduce a fixed palette or bundled display font.
Don’t add glow, ornamental clock motion, or a reveal that delays prayer data.
Don’t replace native shared controls with web approximations.
